title: Exploring the shift to online open-book final exams: The impact on question types and the experiences of students and academics
content:
Chem. Educ. Res. Pract., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4RP00290C, Paper
Alice Lu, Joy Bechara Ghrayche, Reyne Pullen, Stephen George-Williams
The COVID-19 pandemic prompted the shift to online learning, including a change from paper-based (Type-P) exams to online, open-book (Type-O) exams. This study investigated the impact of the sudden shift...
